text: Hello! Ready for today? Here is your weather report for Friday, November 27. Friday at last. One more day and it's the weekend. Looking outside in Shanghai, today will be sunny from start to finish. The high will be 19 degrees, and the low will be 8 degrees. It will feel just right out there. There is almost no chance of rain today. There are 27 days to go until a special day. Can you guess which one? A lovely day to be outside. Let's find some shade and have a picnic. And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be lovely and sunny, with a high of 15 degrees. This week is all about rain on the window. What is your favourite part? And that's it for today's weather. Have a lovely time!
